history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark hair and glasses, wearing a black t-shirt and black pants, stands in a well-lit art gallery, looking intently at a framed black and white drawing on a white wall. The drawing, in a light wooden frame, depicts a figure in a suit standing by a railing, with strong shadows and a sense of depth. To the right of this, another smaller framed piece is visible. The gallery has a modern, minimalist aesthetic with smooth white walls and wooden accents. A track light illuminates the artwork from above. In the background, through an arched opening, a cafe or lounge area is visible with round tables, chairs, and a large, round decorative element, possibly a moon or a lamp, casting a soft glow. The overall mood is one of quiet contemplation and appreciation for art. The lighting is focused and dramatic on the artwork, while the background is softly lit, creating a contrast between the exhibition space and the social area. The color palette is dominated by neutrals – white walls, black clothing, wooden frames, and warm wood tones in the background, with the soft glow of the background lights adding a touch of warmth. The style is contemporary and sophisticated.
